advancedTerms.definition: The published chef packet that states the accepted customer commitment, menu, allergens, quantities, schedule, and station plan.
What the department has promised after acceptance—product, quantity, quality, packaging, and deadline that students must protect.

Finishing delivery, records, dishes, sanitation, storage, and station restoration so the event is truly done.
